1. Extend the image with the border mode by half its size, at most 256 pixels, on each side.
2. Start with v equal to the extended image g, u equal to 0 and rho equal to rho_0.
3. Solve the data step for x with the FFT.
4. Denoise x + u with sigma = sqrt(lambda / rho). This is the new v.
5. Add x - v to u, multiply rho by gamma, and repeat.
6. Crop the last v to the image.
